segments.an9.2:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an9.2:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotī”ti?
segments.an9.2:1.4: “Saddhaṃ ce, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti, pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti.
segments.an9.2:1.5: Hiriṃ ce, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya … pe … ottappaṃ ce, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya … pe … vīriyaṃ ce, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya … pe … paññaṃ ce, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti, pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti.
segments.an9.2:1.9: Taṃ hissa bhikkhuno akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti suppahīnaṃ, yaṃsa ariyāya paññāya disvā pahīnaṃ”.
segments.an9.2:2.1: “Tena ca pana, bhikkhu, bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro upanissāya vihātabbā.
segments.an9.2:2.3: Idha, bhikkhu, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti.
segments.an9.2:2.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotī”ti.

lines: Evaṃ kho bhikkhūti evaṃ kho bhikkhu uggahaparipucchāvasena ceva dhammavavatthānavasena ca paṭisevitabbādīni suppaṭividdhāni supaccakkhāni katvā paṭisevanto adhivāsento parivajjento vinodento ca bhikkhu nissayasampanno nāma hotīti.
